title: Apple's New Macs Are a Local-AI Deployment Ladder

quality.note: Theme rewrite: official Mac Studio and Mac mini pricing announced August 25 (M5 Max $2,499 / M5 Ultra $5,499; M6 mini $899 / M5 Pro $1,699). Original 'price not published' angle was invalidated by the primary release.

items.claim: Apple announced Mac Studio with M5 Max and M5 Ultra on August 25; M5 Max starts at $2,499 and M5 Ultra at $5,499.
items.note: Official press release lists US starting prices and pre-order date.

items.claim: Mac mini with M6 starts at $899 and M5 Pro at $1,699; M6 has 16GB base memory and 12-core CPU/GPU.
items.note: Official press release confirms M6 12-core CPU, 16GB unified memory base, and US pricing.

items.claim: The 16GB M6 Mac mini has 153GB/s memory bandwidth; 24GB and 32GB variants reach 170GB/s.
items.note: Launch-day configuration analysis from Apple's published specs; matches Apple technical specifications.

items.claim: A 7B model could clear 60 tokens per second on a base M6 Mac mini versus roughly 17 on an M4 mini.
items.note: MacStories projection based on published specs; explicitly an estimate, labeled as such in the article.

items.claim: A developer ran a 122B-parameter Qwen model on an M5 Max with 128GB, and r/LocalLLaMA rates 128GB M5 Max as single-user inference leader.
items.note: Community reports from April-May 2026 on M5 Max 128GB hardware; the article labels the 30-45 tok/s figure as an estimate.

items.claim: Four Mac Studio units can cluster over Thunderbolt 5 and RDMA; Apple claims up to 3x faster inference.
items.note: Matches Apple's own press release claim; article notes RDMA predates this launch and independent tests of prior generation measured 122.6%.

items.claim: Media cite China pricing of 19,999 yuan for M5 Max Mac Studio and 46,999 yuan for M5 Ultra.
items.note: Chinese tech media report matches the official China launch pricing; article frames it as media-cited.

claim_check.reason: Article rewritten around the August 25 official Mac lineup announcement and community AI-deployment analysis. Every asserted number is traceable to the cited primary release or the named community/independent source; estimates are labeled as such.

evidence_caveats: 社区性能数字（60 tok/s、30-45 tok/s、122B 本地运行）为估算或社区实测，非 Apple 官方基准。
M6/M5 Pro/M5 Ultra 独立基准尚未出现：机器 9 月 22 日才开始交付。
Apple 的 4.8x/8.5x LLM 数字测的是 time-to-first-token，不是持续生成速度。
seo_title: Apple's New Macs Are a Local-AI Deployment Ladder
seo_summary: Apple's refreshed Mac mini and Mac Studio lineup is a local-AI deployment ladder from 16GB to 512GB of unified memory — with community data on what each tier can actually run.
